title: The Night the Ferry Came Back Empty (with Jen Okafor) | Cold Ledger Ep. 48
creator: Cold Ledger Podcast
description:
In 1997 a small passenger ferry on Lake Harlow returned to the dock with its lights on and nobody aboard. Journalist Jen Okafor spent three years on the case and joins Marcus to walk through what the records actually say.

Jen's book, The Empty Crossing, is out now.
